//instructions: Relative to this file's directory, which is the package root. The agent guidance lives in the sibling dev/ repository rather than here, so that one set of rules covers all four repositories and cannot drift between them. CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/ stay here because they ship to consumers.
//skills: A plain array rather than the V1 `skills.paths` object, which V1 and V2 separate into two keys and V2 combines into one ordered array. A `paths` entry rather than a `.opencode/` directory or a symlink, because this is a git worktree and OpenCode stops walking up at one. A directory under it is invisible to a session started anywhere in this package; a path in this file is not. It points at the sibling dev/ repository, which is where the skills actually live.
